title: One Trip. So Many Moments.
subtitle: The places we discover. The moments we share.

storyboard.scene: An original illustrated arrival postcard swings onto a travelling route. A tiny plane crosses a warm sky above an imagined destination.
The arrival postcard slides into the collection as an original coastal landscape opens. Waves, clouds, palms and a little boat keep moving.
A third postcard celebrates togetherness: three illustrated travellers gather at an outdoor table, with lifting cups and colourful pennants.
A gala postcard arrives with a rising stage, soft moving beams, sparkling lights and guests.
The four original illustrations float into an open travel album; a continuous route connects its pages. Caption identifies the journey as imagined.
Shared Global Connect Travels brand end card.
